text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  moderate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Run AI Moderator
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        env:
          AI_MODERATOR_SPAM_LABEL: spam
          AI_MODERATOR_AI_GENERATED_LABEL: ai-generated
          AI_MODERATOR_MINIMIZE_COMMENT: true
```
